description: I'm Hareesh, team lead of "Galaxy Warriors," and we are excited to participate in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Virudhunagar Local Event! Our team has chosen the critical challenge: "Create Health Monitoring Software for Astronauts on Space Missions." As humanity pushes further into deep space, ensuring the physical and mental well-being of our astronauts becomes one of the most vital hurdles to overcome.
